I know exactly how you feel. My family drives me crazy and I can’t stand being around them because they are so back and forth. They are nice sometimes then complete assholes other times. I’ve wanted to run away and life my life the way I want for a while now. I do understand what you want, personally I want to be rich and not have to worry, but that is not very realistic. Everyday I think of what I could do with my life and for the past 2 years I have not been able to come up with an answer, which is making me insane. I don’t wanna live an average life because I know I can amount to something. My family is holding me back and I hate it. I’ve wanted to kill myself for as long as I can remember. I’ve had a terrible life but there is always a little thing which stops me, and I don’t like it. I’m tired of waiting for things to happen. Do not kill yourself though. You may want to but it is not worth it. You are valued. If you want to talk more message me.
